bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 170, Number 39 (Tuesday, March 5, 2024)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. PALLONE:
H.R. 7520.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Under Article 1, Section 8, Clause 3: [The Congress shall
have Power] To regulate Commerce with foreign Nations, sand
among the several states, and with the Indian Tribes;
The single subject of this legislation is:
To prohibit data brokers from transferring sensitive data
of United States individuals to foreign adversaries, and for
other purposes.
[Page H822]
